description_en: Queries push statistics for a message
description_zh: 查询消息维度的推送统计
name: QueryPushStatByMsg

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the pushed message. This ID is returned after a message is pushed.

> Push data is available the next day. You cannot query data for the current day.
parameters.description_zh:
推送的消息ID，推送之后会返回该ID。
> 推送数据隔天展示，不支持查询今日数据。
